verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals documents first-party escalation policies that route alert notifications to on-call schedules or individual responders, so the core capability exists. However, the evidence never describes the step-by-step walk that defines the story: timed delays between steps, fallback responders, repeat rounds, or escalation halting on acknowledgement. Missing for 10: documented multi-step escalation with per-step delays, fallback/secondary responder tiers, repeat/loop rounds, acknowledgement-driven stop behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
